text:
Asha Patel: Heads-up, postmortem posted for the metering incident on 2026-03-02. Root cause: delayed aggregator job plus a rare retry path that created duplicate token increments. I outlined remediation and owners in the doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/billing-metering-2026

Liam Chen: Ack. Can you attach the per-customer delta so we know who needs invoice fixes?

Maya Ortiz: Quick summary from my initial run: most customers show <0.5% variance. Four customers hit ~5-12% extra token counts due to the retry duplication. I'll run full reconciliation and post CSV.

Maya Ortiz: SQL I used for the slice (pasted to the postmortem):
```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens_reported - tokens_expected) AS token_delta
FROM billing.raw_metering_events
WHERE event_timestamp >= '2026-03-01' AND event_timestamp < '2026-03-03'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY token_delta DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

Tom (acct): For the four impacted accounts I propose: issue provisional invoice credits equal to token_delta * unit_price, then send corrected invoices after reconciliation is final. Need invoice ids + estimated amounts by EOD.

Asha Patel: Owners and ETA: 
- Maya Ortiz: complete per-customer reconciliation, post CSV to the postmortem doc by EOD (owner: @Maya Ortiz).
- Liam Chen: run a safety rehydrate job that dedupes the aggregator and validate on a staging slice by tomorrow AM (owner: @Liam Chen).
- Tom (acct): draft customer credit memos and corrected invoices, hold until reconciliation final (owner: @Tom (acct)).
- Liam / eng-oncall: add monitor for retry-duplication-rate >0.1%/hr, ETA 1 week.

Asha Patel: Recurrence note: aggregator lag tends to spike around midnight UTC during batch window shifts. Added a tech-debt ticket to add an automatic guard to pause ingestion during migration windows.

Liam Chen: Small question on rounding: do we round credit amounts to cents or nearest dollar? want consistent memo language.

Tom (acct): Round to cents. Include the token math in the invoice memo and link to the reconciliation CSV for transparency.

Maya Ortiz: Uploaded CSV to the postmortem: columns = customer_id, invoice_id, token_delta, unit_price, credit_amount, checksum. Sample rows for the 4 customers: CUST-821, INV-9941, 12400, $0.0005, $6.20; CUST-104, INV-9942, 53200, $0.0005, $26.60.

Asha Patel: Good. Next steps: Tom will route notices to Legal if needed before sending. Liam will open a PR for the dedupe guard in the ingestion repo. We'll review progress on Monday's follow-up. Please post status updates as replies to this thread.

billing-bot: Audit note: linked postmortem "billing-metering-2026" by Asha Patel at 1754207920.

Liam Chen: Adding a recurring 2-week check to ensure no reoccurrence; we'll monitor the first 6 weeks closely.

Tom (acct): I'll schedule customer outreach for next Tue after reconciliation is finalized.

Maya Ortiz: My tasks done: CSV + checksums posted. Leaving open until Tom confirms credits issued.

Asha Patel: Thanks all. Tagging @finance for visibility :eyes:
